title: HRDPath predicts homologous recombination deficiency from ovarian cancer slides
summary: HRDPath is a patient-level deep-learning architecture that predicts HRD status in high-grade serous tubo-ovarian carcinoma from whole slide images. Validated across three cohorts it reached an AUC of 0.846, and with multiple slides per patient and targeted optimization sensitivity and specificity both reached 0.90. An interpretability pipeline links HRD-positive cancers to morphological features.
ai_technology: HRDPath explainable multi-model deep-learning architecture on whole slide images
organization: King's College London; Fred Hutchinson Cancer Center

evidence.tested: Three cohorts of patients with high-grade serous tubo-ovarian carcinoma.
evidence.unknown: Retrospective, method-focused; no prospective or treatment-outcome evidence; abstract only; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: Deep learning predicted HRD status from histopathology without additional molecular testing.
